propositions: ShellCheck must be integrated into make lint at -S warning severity to detect SC2115 (unsafe rm -rf glob expansion) which is emitted at warning not error
The pattern rm -rf "${dir}"/* can expand to rm -rf /* under certain conditions and must fail the lint gate, while the hardened form ': "${dir:?}" && cd -- "${dir:?}" && rm -rf -- ./*' must pass
Nine pre-existing ShellCheck findings in two files (infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh and infra/terraform/user_data.sh) must be resolved before the gate can be enabled
The lint gate must fail closed (non-zero exit) when ShellCheck is absent rather than silently skip, and must document the shellcheck-py dependency in local dev environment setup
All 45 tracked *.sh files must be scanned by ShellCheck in the lint gate, excluding vendored directories (.venv/, .git/, .claude/)
